name: תרגום בעיה מילולית לנוסחה – שכר עם שעות נוספות (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Katie's basic wage is £{{CT:0}} per week.

She is also paid another £{{CT:1}} for each hour of overtime that she works.

If \(h\) stands for the number of hours of overtime that she works, and if \(W\) stands for her total wage (in £s). Write down an equation relating \(W\) and \(h\): [[input:ans1]]

[[validation:ans1]]

[[feedback:prt1]] What would Katie's total wage be if she worked {{CT:2}} hours of overtime? £[[input:ans2]]

[[validation:ans2]][[feedback:prt2]]
generalfeedback:
To first work out the equation relating \(W\) and \(h\) we look at the information we are given.

We know that \(W\) stands for her total wage, so that will be on one side of the equation, on the other we have to put her basic wage and take into account any overtime she may work. Given that she is paid £{{CT:1}} for every hour overtime and she works \(h\) hours of over time she gets paid an extra \({{CT:3}} \times h\), and that is on top of the basic wage of £{{CT:0}}. So the equation is:

\[ {{CT:4}} + {{CT:3}}h = W. \] For the second part of the question we have to calculate Katie's actual wage given that she worked {{CT:2}} hours of overtime. So we must replace \(h\) in our equation with the value {{CT:2}} and simplify, i.e. we get: \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle W &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}} + {{CT:3}}h, \\ W &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}} + ({{CT:3}} \times {{CT:5}}), \\ W &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:4}} + {{CT:6}}, \\ W &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:7}}. \end{array}\]

on_false.feedback: Your formula for part one is wrong, but you have evaluated it correctly here! Please try both parts again.
